title: Silas and the Safehouse
author: August Iversen
blurb: Marguerite Kavanagh, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
